<!doctype html><html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Guía rápida del Chillout</title><style>:root{--n:#173b74;--l:#c7d8f3;--t:#1f2937}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#edf3fb;color:var(--t);font:16px Arial;line-height:1.45}main{max-width:980px;margin:auto;padding:12px}header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#173b74,#2d63ae);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,48px)}.c{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--l);border-radius:18px;padding:17px;margin:13px 0}h2,h3{color:var(--n)}.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center}.p{border:1px solid #dbe5f7;border-radius:14px;padding:8px;text-align:center}.p img{display:block;width:120px;height:160px;object-fit:contain;margin:auto;border-radius:8px}.g,.cmds,.zones{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.r{border:1px solid var(--l);border-radius:14px;padding:11px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:135px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center}.r b{display:block;color:var(--n);font-size:19px;margin-bottom:5px}.cmd{border:1px solid var(--l);background:#fafcff;border-radius:12px;padding:11px;font-weight:700}.z{border:2px solid var(--l);background:#f2f6fd;border-radius:14px;padding:14px}.z b{display:block;color:var(--n);font-size:22px}.w{border-left:5px solid #d9483b;background:#fff5f3;padding:13px}@media(max-width:700px){.hero,.g,.cmds,.zones{grid-template-columns:1fr}.r{grid-template-columns:125px 1fr}}@media(max-width:430px){.r{grid-template-columns:1fr}}</style></head><body><main><header><h1>Guía rápida del Chillout</h1><p>Comandos de voz, Fire Stick, mandos originales y soluciones rápidas.</p></header><section class="c hero"><div class="p"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
